_note: BACKSTOP for cards RiftScribe genuinely lacks (e.g. TCGplayer Organized-Play / promotional printings). Most 'missing' cards are just prod being behind the snapshot — run `npm run cards:sync` FIRST. Only add a card here if it's still missing after that. `externalId` must be unique and stable (use it for promos so they never clobber the base card). imageUrl from a TCGplayer product URL tcgplayer.com/product/<ID>/... = https://tcgplayer-cdn.tcgplayer.com/product/<ID>_in_1000x1000.jpg . Any FILL_ME = skipped. Run: `npm run cards:manual` (DRY_RUN=1 to preview).

Nexus Night 1 organized-play promo prints — these were being wrongly scraped and shown on /sealed as a 'Nexus Night Pack' sealed product (fixed in sealed-import.ts), when each is really a single promo printing of an existing base card. Domain/type/rarity inherited from the real OGN base card of the same name. No confirmed distinct collector number exists for these prints, so 'NN1' (Nexus Night 1, the event name on the actual listings) is used as a non-numbered designator, same convention as Buff // Buff's 'P'. Includes the full 6-domain Rune cycle (Fury/Calm/Mind/Body/Chaos/Order) — only Calm and Body were originally added; the other four were the same NN1 promo set and were missing.

Vendetta Signature ('*') Legend pulls — playriftbound.com's own card gallery hasn't posted these yet (Signature prints always trail the base reveal), so fetch-vendetta-official.ts can't see them. Sourced from real eBay listings (buyer-submitted photos, cross-checked against each other for the rules text/collector number), NOT RiftScribe/official art. imageUrl points at our own re-hosted crop of that photo (public/signature-cards/) as a stand-in thumbnail — swap for the official CDN asset once cards-sync/vendetta-pipeline catalogues the real print (same externalId, so it adopts in place, no duplicate). domain is the Legend's FIRST printed domain only, same simplification fetch-vendetta-official.ts's own o.domain.values[0] makes for every other Legend in this file — each of these six is actually dual-domain (Zed Fury/Chaos, Kennen Chaos/Body, Shen Calm/Body, Renekton Fury/Body, Mel Mind/Chaos, Jayce Mind/Body per the two domain pips on the card), the DB just doesn't have a second-domain column yet.
